description: Defines the class DittoAcknowledgementLabel, which provides built-in acknowledgement labels used by the Ditto framework, including static instances, utility methods, and overrides for equality and string representation.

classes.name: DittoAcknowledgementLabel
classes.description: A final class representing specific acknowledgement labels emitted by Ditto, with static instances and utility methods.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an array of the predefined Ditto acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given acknowledgement label is one of the Ditto acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DittoAcknowledgementLabel instances based on their delegate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the delegate label.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the delegate label.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index of the delegate label.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the delegate label.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the delegate label.
